text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $78.5k while Ethereum trades flat, signaling consolidation rather than conviction in either direction despite greed-leaning sentiment. The broad market is slightly negative across altcoins, yet Bitcoin dominance has climbed to 59.2%, suggesting investors are rotating toward the safest asset even as overall trading volume remains robust at $86B. Fear & Greed sits in greed territory but has cooled over the past week, pointing to cautious optimism rather than the euphoria typical of sustained rallies.
